authorization: User explicitly requested attempt 3 and authorized a bounded local experiment.
hypothesis: The rune-bearing LP2/0..55 material is compatible with the prime-minus-one subtractive stream when plaintext F (rune index 0) is copied without consuming the stream. Unknown F positions can therefore be represented by a finite set of reachable consumed-clock states rather than by enumerating complete skip subsets.
mechanistic_basis: C017: LP1/03-04 and LP2/56 have exact known-page evidence for plaintext F copied without advancing the stream.
C018: LP2/56 has exact evidence for a continuous prime-minus-one page clock with the documented exception.
H006-v1: the same no-skip prime family had no frequency lead on LP2/0..55; H007 tests a distinct, mechanism-motivated exception model rather than repeating that family.
falsifiable_predictions: The documented LP2/56 plaintext path, including its single F exception at rune ordinal 56, is reachable from clock 0 under the continuous branch and ends at clock 84.
Three pre-generated synthetic H007 positives, including one with random nonzero and F plaintext values, have their exact private paths reachable under both registered continuity branches.
The one-rune incompatible control ciphertext [1] has no reachable state because C=1 at t=0 would decode to forbidden plaintext F.

For LP2/0..55, every page is evaluated under both continuous corpus flow and page-reset flow. A page with no terminal state is negative only for that fixed branch; any surviving state is compatibility evidence, not a decipherment.
data_versions: all sources/*manifest.json entries verified before dispatch
page_universe: LP2 numeric pages 0..55 in pinned master order
applicable_objects: All 55 LP2 pages containing registered rune tokens, including rune portions of mixed literal pages 49 and 51.

excluded_objects.reason: Pinned source has no registered rune tokens; literal grid is outside this rune-domain state model. It is unexecuted, not negative.

algorithm_version: H007-v1: d[t]=(prime[t]-1) mod29, offset=0, shift=1, subtractive inverse. For C!=0, P=(C-d[t]) mod29 and the transition is retained only when P!=0, consuming t. For C=0, retain P=0 with t unchanged and also retain P=(-d[t]) mod29 when nonzero, consuming t. Merge states with identical processed position and t; cap path multiplicity at 2 only for ambiguity diagnostics.
parameter_derivation_policy: No keyword, offset, shift, direction, affine family, dictionary, language score, or output-selected skip set. Only the fixed prime-minus-one stream and the two preregistered continuity branches are evaluated.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: Evaluate the complete LP2/0..55 numeric order as one continuous batch, and independently evaluate the same pages with t reset to 0 at each page. Literals and separators are not in the public rune sequence and do not consume the stream.

reset_branches.continuous: Carry every reachable t from LP2/n to LP2/(n+1), starting LP2/0 at t=0.
reset_branches.page_reset: Start each page at t=0; do not carry states across pages.

literals_and_ambiguity: The worker receives only registered rune indices 0..28. Original raw text, separators, line/paragraph boundaries, glyph ambiguity, and source hashes remain in orchestrator-side provenance; no silent normalization is performed.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.score: None. H003 short-text scorer calibration is not part of this attempt.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.algorithmic_control_pass: Independent set-based recurrence must match the worker state counts, terminal clocks, capped path counts, edge counts, first-dead position, and state digest for every public batch and branch; private known/synthetic paths must satisfy the registered transition relation; the incompatible control must be rejected.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.unsolved_page_negative: A fixed branch with zero terminal states after complete coverage is negative only for H007-v1 on that page/continuity and its exact pinned ciphertext.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.unsolved_page_inconclusive: A fixed branch with one or more terminal states is inconclusive: reachability alone does not choose a plaintext, prove uniqueness of the mechanism, or count as a decrypted page.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.decipherment: No LP2/0..55 page is accepted as decrypted in this attempt. A readable-looking witness, a unique endpoint, or reverse arithmetic alone is insufficient without an independent structural/key prediction.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner records this specification, all source/data hashes, public ciphertext hash, verifier-only control answers, code snapshot, and UTC timestamp before invoking the guarded worker.

total_budget.state_transitions: At most 2 transitions per reachable state per rune; no complete F-subset enumeration.
total_budget.origin: Bounded local budget selected for this explicit attempt 3; no side-chat budget inherited.

controls: Known LP2/56 private reference plaintext from a separate markdown block; expected H007 path has one F exception and final clock 84.
Three deterministic synthetic positives: two heldout-text slices and one seeded random plaintext, encrypted by the registered H007 rule; seeds and plaintext remain verifier-only.
One incompatible one-rune control [1] with no legal H007 path.
Three deterministic uniform random ciphertext controls, observed but not scored or treated as proof of either solvability or failure.
Independent set recurrence, prime generation, exact transition replay, and worker read-isolation/field-whitelist checks.
correlated_transform_deduplication: Not applicable: H007 is a single state transition model. The continuous and page-reset branches are reported separately and are not deduplicated by coincident summaries.
multiple_testing_policy: No language ranking or significance test is performed. Page/branch rows are descriptive compatibility results only; no maximum-score claim is made.

randomness.role: Verifier-only synthetic/random-control generation; no seed is passed to the worker.

discovery_path: Guarded -I -S worker receives only fixed public ciphertext rune indices and job ids. It cannot read files, reference answers, plaintext, seeds, network, or subprocesses.
independent_validation_path: The orchestrator separately generates the prime stream and recomputes the recurrence with Python sets; it checks every public result summary and replays private expected paths without importing the worker transition function.
uncovered_parameters: other cipher layers or affine transforms
alternate transcriptions or unverified glyph corrections
language scoring and dictionary-based path selection
next_step: If controls pass, inspect the per-page state-width pattern. Do not call surviving paths plaintext; choose H003 scorer calibration or a separately preregistered mechanism only after reviewing this coverage.
note: This specification freezes a reachability experiment, not a claim that any unknown page is solved.
